Select the first 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL1293249. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pchembl_value. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
